headline: 60 km/h storm and lightning expected in Dhaka and other districts by 9 AM
summary: Several districts, including the capital Dhaka, are under alert for severe weather conditions. Residents are advised to take necessary precautions as strong winds and thunderstorms are forecast.
details: A severe weather alert has been issued for Dhaka and several other districts across Bangladesh. Forecasts indicate the possibility of storms accompanied by lightning, with wind speeds reaching up to 60 kilometers per hour.
The Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD) has advised residents to remain vigilant. The adverse weather conditions are anticipated to occur by 9 AM, urging early morning preparedness.
